title: Pell's Equation, I
notes: Undated expository note, read 22 September 2026. Theorem 5.3 on pages 6-7 identifies all positive solutions of x^2-Dy^2=1 with positive powers of a fundamental unit. Examples 5.5 and 5.6 give D=2 and D=3; Example 5.8 gives D=m^2-1. These are the classical inputs to docs/problems/juggler_pell_invariant_domain.md. The OOE endpoint bracket is the dossier's application, not a theorem claimed by this source.
